At Northline, we protect the systems people rely on. Position Summary   We are seeking a Principal Incident Response Lead to serve as the dedicated incident command and response program lead. This role coordinates cross-functional response efforts and maintains incident command structure during active events.    The ideal candidate thrives in fast-paced environments and can drive complex incidents from detection through post-incident review.     Key Responsibilities    Own the incident response roadmap, governance, standards, playbooks, severity model, metrics, and executive reporting.  Lead end-to-end response for security incidents, including preparation, detection, containment, recovery, and post-incident learning.  Improve MTTD, MTTC, MTTR, observability, and response orchestration.    Qualifications    10+ years of cybersecurity experience, including deep expertise in incident response, security operations, threat hunting, or investigations.  Proven ability to lead enterprise-scale incident response programs in SaaS, cloud, hybrid, and multicloud environments.  Strong knowledge of modern attack techniques, incident management, executive communications, and cross-functional crisis coordination.  Understanding of application delivery and security architectures, including load balancing, reverse proxy, WAF, API security, DDoS protection, and Kubernetes ingress.  Experience using the following log sources, CrowdStrike endpoint detections, EDR process and network events, SIEM alerts, WAF events, DLP alerts, vulnerability signals, and network and edge logs.  Experience influencing strategy across large organizations without direct authority; familiarity with NIST, ISO, SOC, PCI, and GDPR requirements preferred.  Ability to support global incident response operations from US.  FedRAMP eligible    Success Measures   Success in the first 12 to 18 months will be measured by improved response maturity and faster detection, containment and recovery.     Role Details:  Principal Individual Contributor, focused on incident response and executive engagement.      The Job Description is intended to be a general representation of the responsibilities and requirements of the job. However, the description may not be all-inclusive, and responsibilities and requirements are subject to change.   The annual base pay for this position is: $180,000.00 - $270,000.00   You may also be offered incentive compensation, bonus, restricted stock units, and benefits. More details about benefits can be found at the following link:  https://example.com/benefits  .  Northline reserves the right to change or terminate any benefit plan without notice.
